meta.title: Luma.Green — Cleaner Tomorrow in Motion
meta.description: Luma.Green connects recyclers, collectors and factories in the same sector: manage inventory, trade recovered material, and settle verified carbon credits in one place.

footer.about: India's scrap chain on one platform, from the home to the factory. Every hand-off weighed, priced and recorded.

recover.title: Recover
recover.summary: Material is collected, weighed and recorded into your organisation's inventory.

trade.title: Trade
trade.summary: Organisations in the same sector list lots, agree terms and settle trades.

retire.title: Retire
retire.summary: A settled trade mints carbon credits that are verified, held, traded and finally retired.

principles.heading: Built to stand up to an audit
principles.intro: A regulator may ask how any credit was produced. The ledger is designed so the answer is always on record.

auditable.title: Every change is on the record
auditable.body: Each state change — stock received, trade settled, credit retired — writes an entry to an audit log that is never edited in place.

exact.title: Numbers that never drift
exact.body: Money is kept in whole paise and mass in whole grams. No rounding error can build up between a weighbridge and a settlement.

frozen.title: Issued credits stay issued
frozen.body: A credit keeps the emission factor used when it was issued. Revising a factor later never rewrites a credit that already exists.

home.metaDescription: Luma.Green puts India's scrap chain on one platform: households, kabadiwalas, yards, recyclers and manufacturers, with fair prices, verified businesses and a receipt at every step.

hero.title: India's scrap chain, on one platform
hero.lead: Sell scrap from home at a fair price. Trade it up the chain with verified businesses. Every hand-off is weighed, priced and recorded.

teaser.title: Today's prices
teaser.unavailable: Today's prices will show here soon.

chain.heading: How scrap moves
chain.intro: Scrap changes hands four times before it becomes something new. It is sorted better at every step, and Luma.Green records every hand-off.

household.name: Households
household.body: Sell old paper, plastic, metal and e-waste.

yard.body: Grade it and press it into bales.

recycler.name: Recyclers
recycler.body: Turn bales into flakes, granules and ingots.

manufacturer.name: Manufacturers
manufacturer.body: Make new products from recycled material.

chain.saathi: Saathis help all along the chain with pickups, sorting and shifts.

verified.body: A person checks every business and every Saathi before they can trade.

escrow.body: The buyer's money is held safely and released when the goods arrive.

receipts.body: Every pickup and trade gets a receipt: what, how much and at what price.

whyNow.heading: Why now
whyNow.intro: Three changes make this the moment to put India's scrap chain on record.

epr.title: EPR rules
epr.body: Extended Producer Responsibility rules for plastic packaging, e-waste and batteries ask producers to prove that material was really collected and recycled. That proof has to start at the first hand-off.

informal.body: Kabadiwalas and informal workers already do much of India's recycling, with little access to fair prices, records or recognition. Luma.Green works with them, not around them.

standards.metaDescription: Open material codes and simple rules for fair scrap trade in India: grading, weighing, receipts, verification and escrow. Free for anyone to adopt.
standards.title: The Luma.Green standard
standards.lead: Simple, open rules for trading scrap fairly: one code for every material, clear grading, honest weighing and a record at every hand-off. Anyone in the industry can adopt them.

codes.title: One code for every material
codes.body: The same scrap goes by many local names. An open code gives each material one name everyone can use, so a kilo of newspaper means the same thing at a shop, a yard and a factory.
codes.caption: Luma.Green material codes
codes.unavailable: The code list isn't available right now. Please check back soon.

grading.title: Grading: dry, sorted, clean
grading.body: A fair price needs a clear grade. Three checks come before any weighing.

dry.title: Dry
dry.body: Water is not scrap. Wet paper and cardboard are dried before they are weighed.

sorted.title: Sorted
sorted.body: One material per bag or bale, under one code. A mixed load goes under a MIXED code.

clean.title: No contamination
clean.body: No food, oil, soil or stones. Anything that isn't the material comes out first.

weighing.title: Fair weighing
weighing.body: Most arguments in scrap are about weight. These rules keep the scale honest.

stamped.title: Stamped scales
stamped.body: Weigh only on a scale verified and stamped by the Legal Metrology department.

shown.title: The seller sees the weight
shown.body: The display faces the seller, and the weight is read out before a price is agreed.

receipt.title: A digital receipt
receipt.body: The weight goes on a receipt to the gram, never rounded in anyone's favour.

custody.title: Receipts and chain of custody
custody.body: Every hand-off gets a receipt. Receipts link from step to step, so a bale at a recycler can be traced back to the shops it came from.

fields.total: Total, and how it was paid

verification.title: Verification
verification.body: A person checks every business and every Saathi before they can trade.
verification.business: Businesses: the GST number if they have one, photos of the shop or unit, and a phone call.
verification.consent: Yards, recyclers and factories: a valid consent from the state pollution control board.
verification.saathi: Saathis: a photo ID and a selfie that matches it.

escrow.title: Escrow between businesses
escrow.body: In a trade between businesses, nobody ships or pays on trust alone. The money waits in escrow until the goods arrive.

steps.released: The buyer confirms, and the money is released

adopt.title: Use the standard
adopt.body: The codes and rules are open and free. Use them in your shop, yard or factory, on Luma.Green or off it, and tell us what would make them better.

howItWorks.metaDescription: How material moves through Luma.Green: recovered into inventory, traded within a sector, and turned into verified carbon credits that are held and retired.
howItWorks.title: How Luma.Green works
howItWorks.lead: Every screen in Luma.Green is a view onto one circular flow. Here is what happens at each step, and what the ledger records.

recover.body: Collectors and aggregators record material as it arrives. Stock is never typed in directly — it is the sum of recorded movements, so every kilogram can be traced to where it came from.
recover.point1: Log collections by material and grade
recover.point3: Stock derived from an append-only movement history

trade.body: Organisations list lots to others in their sector, agree terms and settle. Stock is reserved when a trade is accepted, so the same material cannot be promised to two buyers.
trade.point1: Listings visible only within your sector
trade.point2: Stock reserved the moment a trade is accepted
trade.point3: Prices and totals kept in whole paise

retire.body: A settled trade mints carbon credits using the emission factor in force at that moment. Verifiers sign them off; they can then be held, transferred and finally retired.
retire.point3: Transfers and retirements recorded, never overwritten

participants.metaDescription: Luma.Green is built for collectors, aggregators, recyclers, factories and verifiers working in the same recycling sector.

participants.lead: Everyone who touches recovered material in a sector — from the first pickup to the final audit.

recycler.body: Buy lots and process them back into feedstock, with the origin of every lot on record.
